generate_data_for_instance: generate LNS imitation data for a MIP instance from a dataset with configurable neighbourhood size and sequence length
get_incumbent: retrieve a MIP solution from a pickle file by instance name and solution index
get_flipped_vars: compute which binary variables were flipped between an incumbent and an improved solution
enhance_root_features: add incumbent variable values and integer mask columns to root feature arrays
run_generate_data_for_instance: run expert data generation for a MIP instance using SCIP with local branching improvements
